_comment: Default vcs-personality banner profile. Same shape as VCS output, branded vamos. Copy to ~/.config/vamos/banners/ or ./.vamos/banners/ and edit (e.g. set brand) to change it; select with --vamos-banner=<name|path> or $VAMOS_BANNER. Placeholders: {brand} {Brand} {BRAND} {BRAND_SPACED} {version} {personality} {tops_lines} {exe} {cpu} {cpu_compile} {cpu_elab} {simtime} {status}. There is deliberately no slot for vendor licence/copyright text.
compile_done:
{Brand}: ./{exe} is up to date
CPU time: {cpu_compile:.3f} seconds to compile + {cpu_elab:.3f} seconds to elab
